name: Untied Embeddings
tagline: Decouple input token embedding from output projection: separate $W_E$ for $\mathrm{wte}$ and $W_O$ for the LM head.
formula: $$h_0 = W_E[x] + W_P[\mathrm{pos}],\qquad p(\hat{x}) = \mathrm{softmax}\bigl(W_O\,h_L\bigr),\quad W_O \in \mathbb{R}^{V\times d},\; W_O \neq W_E$$
diff_from_baseline: Press & Wolf, 'Using the Output Embedding to Improve Language Models' (EACL 2017) (this baseline is the untied alternative). Adds a separate $V\times d$ output projection rather than tying it to $W_E$. Common when extra parameters are acceptable; trades capacity for representation flexibility.

name: Value Embeddings
tagline: Add learned value-embedding tables that inject token-level residuals into selected transformer layers via per-layer learnable lambdas.
diff_from_baseline: Reference: KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt records #14-15 and #63. Five token-indexed value-embedding tables are looked up once and injected as residuals at early layers (1, 2) and the last three layers, scaled by per-layer learnable $\lambda$.

name: Bigram Hash Embeddings
tagline: Augment token + position embeddings with a hash-based bigram embedding (XOR of consecutive token IDs into a 5x table) injected at every layer.
formula: $$\mathrm{hash}(x_t, x_{t-1}) = (a\,x_t \oplus b\,x_{t-1}) \bmod (5V-1),\;\; a=36313,\,b=27191,\qquad h_\ell \leftarrow h_\ell + \lambda_\ell \, W_B[\mathrm{hash}(x_t,x_{t-1})]$$
diff_from_baseline: Reference: KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt record #62. XOR-hash of $(x_t, x_{t-1})$ indexes into a $5V \times d$ bigram table that is added (with per-layer $\lambda$) at every transformer layer; captures local context without growing the tokenizer.
